caption: The drawing shows a wooden mannequin with articulated joints standing upright on a rectangular wooden platform. The mannequin is brown with visible wood grain detail, and its arms, legs, and head are composed of cylindrical and rounded sections, connected with visible joint lines at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees. Around the mannequin’s waist, there are two wraps of a lighter color, resembling thin bands of fabric or tape. A curved black metal rod extends from a small rectangular wooden block at the base, attaches to the back of the mannequin for support, and is anchored on the left side of the platform. The platform’s wood has a distinct grain pattern, shaded with a mix of light and dark brown tones. The background is plain and off-white, with a few faint brownish stains or marks. The artist’s signature “David Ramage” is visible at the lower right corner.
title: Jigging Figure
